features.name: Divine Fury
features.desc: While raging, the first target you hit on each turn takes extra damage: 1d6 + half your Barbarian level (round down). Choose the type — Necrotic or Radiant.

grants.note: +1d6+{halfLevel} Necrotic/Radiant damage to the first target each turn (while raging)

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.desc: A spell that returns you to life doesn't require a Material component.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.desc: Once per Rage, you can reroll a failed saving throw.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you give up to 10 creatures Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 turn.

features.name: Rage Beyond Death
features.desc: While raging, you don't fall Unconscious at 0 Hit Points (unless killed outright); you keep fighting until your Rage ends.
